description: Create a system in the organization's infrastructure inventory (write — editor+ role). Systems can be linked to capabilities and evidence.

catalog_template_id.description: System-catalog template ID to link — obtain from scf_list_system_catalog

criticality.description: Business criticality — one of: low, medium, high, critical

data_classification.description: Highest classification of data held — one of: public, internal, confidential, restricted

hosting_location.description: Where the system runs, e.g. a cloud region or data centre

in_scope.description: Inside the assessment boundary (true) or outside (false); omit when not decided

system_type.description: System classification — one of: cloud_provider, identity_provider, ticketing, logging, security_tool, code_repository, document_management, endpoint_management, vulnerability_management, email_security, security_awareness, password_manager, communication, hr_system, custom

vendor.description: Legacy free-text vendor name (prefer vendor_id for a structural link)

vendor_id.description: Vendor UUID to structurally link this system to — obtain from scf_list_vendors (same org)

name: scf_create_system
